note: R5 delegation idempotency reservations (libs/core/workforce/delegation-idempotency.ts): one JSON per idempotency key holding the payload hash and the terminal DelegationResult used for replay; a registered tier/tenant-partitioned runtime-state root (PARTITIONED_RUNTIME_STATE_ROOTS.delegation_idempotency): tenant reservations live under confidential/<tenant>/ (tier-guarded, removed by tenant offboarding), untenanted ones under system/. Deleting a terminal reservation re-enables execution for that key, so removal is a reviewed decision.
